intro.title: Persuasion and checking rules
items: Conditions for the “Persuade” command: the selected unit's main pilot is the persuader and hasn't finished acting this turn (having moved is fine); the target is in an orthogonally adjacent square (diagonals don't count); and the prerequisites for this persuasion are met — a multi-step persuasion requires the previous step first {+}

The game decides the persuade target: if one persuader is adjacent to two persuadable targets at once, only the one registered first in the stage is persuaded. For example, if Takeru is adjacent to both Marg and Rose, only Marg is persuaded; if Judau is adjacent to both Mashymre and Chara, only Mashymre is persuaded {+}

Each persuade uses up the persuader's action for the turn, and each persuade can be done only once per stage. If the event's condition isn't met at the time (e.g. persuading Rosamia while Gates is still on the map), that persuade still counts as used and can't be retried this stage {+}

Persuading by itself doesn't make the target leave or join; the effect varies by character: some leave on the spot, some switch to your side on the spot, some are only registered at the end of the stage; after a suspend save and resume, persuades already done still count as done {+}
“Turn N” always means the turn number shown on screen; “within turn N” includes turn N. “N or fewer enemies remain” includes exactly N
“On the map” means the unit is on the map; shot down, withdrawn or not yet appeared all count as not on the map
Parts drop only when one of your units shoots down the carrier in battle (attacking or countering); story defeats, retreats and persuade departures give nothing
The conditions on this page come from this project's analysis of the game script and program; items marked “not verified in game” are static conclusions not yet tested in play

entries.title: Kurtz + Virose (including Super Earthgain)
entries.applies: Brad; recruitable on the Independence Army / OZ routes, only the story changes on the Complete Pacifism route
entries.summary: Brad shoots down Kurtz twice in total, one of them in the branching stage; then, at the moment Kurtz is shot down in “Time to Settle It”, Brad's kills must have reached 100 {≠}

steps.stage_title: The Gundam That Leads to Ruin / Shapiro, Reborn!
steps.text: In “The Gundam That Leads to Ruin”, Kurtz appears on the player phase of turn 3 or when 12 or fewer enemies remain; in “Shapiro, Reborn!” he appears on the enemy phase of turn 4, and if Brad isn't on the map then, he withdraws immediately. Shoot him down with Brad; a shoot-down on Brad's counterattack also counts {+}
Kurtz appears as a third party when the enemy is wiped out or in the turn 4 player phase; Brad can shoot him down here
Kurtz appears in the turn 3 player phase or when the enemy is down to 15 or fewer; he retreats immediately if Brad isn't on the map
Kurtz appears when the enemy is down to 6 or fewer; he retreats immediately if Brad isn't on the map

Kurtz appears on turn 4 or when the enemy is wiped out. In this stage Brad must shoot him down again, and that one also counts toward the two; once the conditions are met, clearing the stage goes straight to “Time to Settle It”, with no choice {≠}{≠}
Kurtz appears in the second wave after the enemy is wiped out. Same as before: have Brad shoot him down; after two times in total you automatically go to “Time to Settle It”
Only Brad deploys, one-on-one with Kurtz; the game is over if Brad is destroyed. Brad's kill count is checked the moment Kurtz is shot down; 100 or more means success {+}{≠}

entries.result: Kurtz + Virose (3 upgrade levels) join; once both reach level 35, the Earthgain and Virose can use the combination attack “Shorai Tenryu Mametsujin” {+}
notes: Recruiting Kurtz means you never switch to the Super Earthgain; it is one or the other, and the Super Earthgain does not have “Shorai Tenryu Mametsujin”

When the switch to the Super Earthgain happens: if “Time to Settle It” wasn't reached → on clearing the branching stage; if it was reached but kills were under 100 → at the start of the next stage {+}
It only matters whether the other side in the fight is Brad: someone else shooting down Kurtz doesn't count, but doesn't void earlier counts either

After the branch you return to your route: the Independence Army route continues with “Mars and Marg”, the OZ route with “Storm of Kilimanjaro”, and every later stage number is 1 higher than without the branch

The Complete Pacifism route has no “Time to Settle It”. If Brad shoots down Kurtz in “What We Fight For” and the total reaches two, Kurtz survives and hands over the Virose himself, but doesn't join; in both versions of the story you swap to the Super Earthgain when the stage is cleared {+}
Whether the shoot-down of Kurtz itself counts toward the 100 is unconfirmed; to be safe, reach 100 before entering “Time to Settle It” {?}
After recruiting Kurtz, 7 later stages have extra Kurtz lines (see “Dialogue-only branches”)
akurasu_notes: Akurasu says “shoot him down twice before the branching stage”; the script only checks at the shoot-down in the branching stage, so Brad must shoot down Kurtz in the branching stage, and that one also counts toward the two
Akurasu's summary table says the 100 kills must be reached before the branching stage ends; the script checks only at the moment Kurtz is shot down in “Time to Settle It”
Akurasu's flowchart says pick the 3rd option at the end of the branching stage; Brad's scenario has no choice here — if the conditions are met you go straight to “Time to Settle It”
Akurasu only says the Complete Pacifism route can't get Kurtz, and doesn't mention the story branch where Kurtz survives and hands over the Virose

steps.text: Persuade Aisha with Manami (first step, no prerequisite)
Then persuade Aisha with Manami (requires the first step)

steps.text: Checked once on the turn 3 player phase or when 7 or fewer enemies remain, whichever comes first: Manami on the map → Aisha switches to your side on the spot; not on the map → fails for good {≠}{?}

Manami cannot deploy this stage (still in the roster); Aisha joins at the end of the stage {+}{≠}

notes: When Manami switches to the Sweemurg S: if Aisha is recruited, at the end of the stage where she joins; if not, at the start of “Earth Sphere in Chaos” on the Independence Army route, at the start of “Storm of Kilimanjaro” on the OZ route, and at the end of “Dark Clouds over the Earth Sphere” on the Complete Pacifism route {+}
On the Independence Army and Complete Pacifism routes you can control Aisha directly in the stage she joins; on the OZ route she is only registered at the end of the stage
Whether the Elbulls stays in the hangar as a pilotless unit after joining is unconfirmed {?}
If Aisha was not recruited, in the story she survives and goes home, handing the Elbulls to Manami to rebuild the Sweemurg {+}
In “The Gundam That Leads to Ruin”, Manami's two-way choice toward Aisha only changes dialogue

Akurasu says turn 2 on the Complete Pacifism route; the script's timing falls on the turn 3 player phase
Akurasu says the OZ route gets the join at the start of “Storm of Kilimanjaro”; the script registers it at the end of that stage, and Manami can't deploy in it

Allenby appears on the player phase of turn 7 or when the first enemy wave is wiped out; persuade her with Domon (requires step 1); she joins at the end of the stage

entries.applies: Common

entries.applies: Common; any time after obtaining the corresponding Gundam
entries.summary: Once all five unit upgrades of the five Gundam W protagonist units are maxed, they automatically change to the EW versions

steps.text: Upgrade all five stats (HP, EN, Mobility, Armor, Limit) to the original cap of 7; checked right after each upgrade you confirm

notes: Only the five unit upgrades matter; weapon upgrades don't
The refit is permanent. To keep the TV version, leave one stat below max

The five stat levels carry over to the EW versions. Some weapons disappear: Deathscythe Hell's Buster Shield, Heavyarms' Army Knife, Altron's Beam Cannon, and Sandrock's Homing Missile / Shield Flash / Beam Machine Gun; the Sandrock Custom additionally gets the Cross Crusher
In the original, the Altron's Dragon Fire upgrade level doesn't carry over to the Custom; this port's optional rule “Machine swap: carry over three weapons the table misses” adds it
With this port's optional rule “Upgrade cap” on, the check still uses the original cap of 7: the change happens when all five stats reach 7, after which the EW version can keep upgrading to 15

entries.result: The OZ route runs straight through to the end; the Independence Army route also splits off the Complete Pacifism route at “The Battle of Ryozanpaku”
notes: Choosing OZ makes Wufei and the Shenlong Gundam leave
Only choosing OZ here lets you get the mass-produced Nu Gundam later
OZ route only: Gato, FA Hyaku-Shiki Kai, mass-production Nu Gundam
Independence Army route only (not Complete Pacifism): Rosamia, Hilde + Taurus, Gundam Mk-III + Methuss Kai, Neue Ziel

entries.title: The Battle of Ryozanpaku: Complete Pacifism route
entries.applies: Independence Army route
entries.summary: Pick option 3 at the start and option 2 after the stage to switch to the Complete Pacifism route

steps.text: Pick option 3 at the start (the trusting, agreeing answer, e.g. Ark's “I want to believe it can come true”), then option 2 after the stage (the answer wanting to help, e.g. Ark's “I wish there were something we could do to help”) → Complete Pacifism route (next stage “Spreading Malice”); any other combination → “The Call of Space”

entries.result: Enters the Complete Pacifism route; it splits once more when “Return to the Battlefield” is cleared
notes: Complete Pacifism route exclusive: Minerva X, MP Great Mazinger
Brad can't get Kurtz (“What We Fight For” may show Kurtz surviving, but he doesn't join)
Ark only needs to persuade Ehrlich once in “What We Fight For”, and he joins on the spot
Without the qualifying stages for Rosamia, Four's last two steps, Gundam Mk-III + Methuss Kai and Kyral, these can't be obtained
After the Complete Pacifism route, you can't get the Neue Ziel whichever route you merge into later; if you moved to the with-Treize branch, Quattro still returns in the Hyaku-Shiki {+}
If you did Allenby's step 1, you can save her and recruit her later at Lantau or in Fist of Despair {+}

entries.title: Return to the Battlefield: with Treize or going it alone
entries.applies: Complete Pacifism route
entries.summary: The choice after clearing “Return to the Battlefield” decides whether you merge into the OZ route or the Independence Army route

steps.text: After the stage, choose “Side with Treize” → Treize branch: Fierce Fighting in Space → The Man Back from Jupiter → Brothers → merges into the OZ route at “Prelude to Ruin”

Pick “We'll fight on our own” → The Galactic Empire's Threat → White Fang → In a World of Endless Strife (Part 1) and Part 2 → merges into the Independence Army route at “Galactic Empire Vanguard Fleet”

entries.result: After merging, it continues with that route's second-half flow
notes: Treize branch: Zechs + Gundam Epyon join at the start of “Brothers”; Hilde joins at the end of “The Man Back from Jupiter” (pilot only)
The Treize branch can't get the mass-production Nu Gundam (it only goes to players who picked OZ in Operation Daybreak)
Fight alone: Hilde is unobtainable, and there is no chance to persuade Naida {+}
The stages for persuading Rose vary by branch (see Rose)

entries.title: Tallgeese Destroyed: Romefeller side or Moon Attack side
entries.applies: OZ route
entries.summary: The choice after clearing “Tallgeese Destroyed” decides the next stage

steps.text: After the stage, choose “I can't obey Romefeller” → The Moon Is Hell! (Romefeller side); choose “We act as OZ to the very end” → Moon Attack (Moon Attack side)

entries.result: The Moon Attack side continues to “The Man Who Could Not Become God” → “The Chaos Never Ends”; on the Romefeller side it depends on whether you hold the base (see “The Moon Is Hell!: holding the base”); the two sides merge at “Because of That Purity”
notes: Gato can only be obtained on the Romefeller side
There is one more choice at the start: “Fight the Empire first” makes Zechs switch to your side on the spot and fight alongside you; “Fight Zechs too” only changes dialogue. Does not affect the route
Ginrei's kill-count check happens at the start of this stage
The protagonist-exclusive content works differently on each side: Aisha and Rish each have one dialogue choice; on the Romefeller side Ehrlich must be persuaded once beforehand

entries.title: The Moon Is Hell!: holding the base
entries.applies: OZ route, Romefeller side
entries.summary: Whether you hold the base decides whether Gato stays and the next two stages

steps.text: Your flagship enters the base first, or wipe out the Muge forces (including Shapiro's reinforcements) and then the Yellow third party in order → Gato joins, next stages “Where Ambition Leads” → “The Nightmare Returns”; Scirocco or Bask himself enters the base first → “The Man Who Could Not Become God” → “The Chaos Never Ends” {≠}{?}

entries.result: The two lines merge at “Because of That Purity”
notes: Gale (Real): joins at the start of “The Nightmare Returns” if Gato is in the party, otherwise at the end of “The Chaos Never Ends”
Rish (Selain) joins at the start of the next stage, the same on both branches
The lineups of “Because of That Purity”, “Scirocco Rises” and “Vortex of Space” afterwards also differ depending on whether Gato joined (see Gato) {+}
akurasu_notes: Akurasu says don't let any Yellow unit enter the base; the script only checks Scirocco and Bask themselves

entries.title: Ark / Brad exclusive side branch
entries.applies: Ark or Brad; Independence Army / OZ routes
entries.summary: Once Ehrlich's or Kurtz's conditions are met, you play one extra stage, “Together from Here On” or “Time to Settle It”

steps.text: Ark: persuade Ehrlich and choose option 2 after the stage → “Together from Here On”; Brad: meet Kurtz's conditions → automatically enters “Time to Settle It”
Same as above

entries.result: After the branch you return to your route: the Independence Army route continues with “Mars and Marg”, the OZ route with “Storm of Kilimanjaro”; every later stage number is 1 higher than without the branch
notes: For conditions see “Ehrlich + Norouz” and “Kurtz + Virose”
Only Ark deploys in “Together from Here On”; the game is over if any enemy enters the target building area or Ark is destroyed {+}
Only Brad deploys in “Time to Settle It”; the game is over if Brad is destroyed {+}
Selain and Manami don't have this branch; neither does the Complete Pacifism route

entries.title: Lera branch: Those Eyes Reflect No Future
entries.applies: Real; affects all three routes
entries.summary: Two choices involving Lera decide whether the Lera branch is active

steps.text: Opening three-way choice: either “Talk with Lera” or “Try to get Lera off the ship” works; “Ignore her” must be made up for in Operation Daybreak {≠}

At the start, pick “Say hello to Lera” (picking “Leave her be” fails it). If you picked “Ignore her” in the previous stage, there is one more choice: Ark picks “I was wrong last time,” Selain picks “That’s true, but...” {≠}
If the condition is met the next stage is “Those Eyes Reflect No Future”, otherwise “Enter! Super Electromagnetic Robo”

entries.result: The Independence Army route goes to “Those Eyes Reflect No Future” (Lera is killed); all paths then continue with “Sortie into Turmoil”
notes: Both stages give the same at the end: the Double Spazer, the Drill Spazer and Maria
This is also a prerequisite for recruiting Ehrlich on the Independence Army route (see Ehrlich) {≠}

Complete Pacifism route: Lera leaves at the start of “Purification”; OZ route: in “Humanity's Victory, and Then... (Part 2)” Lera sees through Marquis Janus posing as Sally, is taken hostage and dies at the end of the stage; the deployment lineup is the same as when the branch isn't active {+}
Dialogue in over ten other stages also changes accordingly
Super has none of these choices and always goes to “Enter! Super Electromagnetic Robo”
akurasu_notes: Akurasu only says pick the 2nd option at the start of “Ideals, Shattered”; in the script the 1st also works, you must pick “Call out to Lera” in Operation Daybreak, and if you picked the 3rd option you can make up for it in Operation Daybreak

entries.title: Cyber Beast Force Base: the three teams split up
entries.applies: Independence Army route (including the Complete Pacifism “fight alone” branch)
entries.summary: After clearing “All-Out Attack on the Cyber Beast Force Base”, choose which team to go with

steps.stage_title: All-Out Attack on the Cyber Beast Force Base
steps.text: After the stage, choose “Go with the main force” → straight to “Desperate Breakthrough (Part 1)”; choose “Go with Domon and the others” → Death Match! Showdown on Lantau Island (Part 1) / (Part 2); choose “Go with Hyoma and the others” → Empress Janera's Human Hunt

entries.result: All three lines merge at “Desperate Breakthrough (Part 1)”
notes: The Lantau branch has two extra stages and the Janera branch one, so later stage numbers shift up accordingly
Lantau branch: Allenby, if in the party, turns on you and has to be won back (see Allenby); Burning Gundam learns Sekiha Tenkyoken one stage earlier

Weapons are largely unaffected by this choice: Combattler V's four attacks come at the start of “Desperate Breakthrough (Part 1)” on all three paths, and Sekiha Tenkyoken also comes there on the other two paths (see story-unlocked finishers and combination attacks) {≠}
For enemy lineups on the Janera branch, see “Janera branch: Super Beasts and reinforcements”
The opening story of “Desperate Breakthrough (Part 1)” differs with this choice
akurasu_notes: Akurasu says the Janera branch adds Combattler V's four weapons and the Lantau branch adds Sekiha Tenkyoken; in the script all three branches get both

entries.title: Desperate Breakthrough: 10-turn limit
entries.applies: Independence Army route (including the Complete Pacifism “fight alone” branch)
entries.summary: Clearing both parts within 10 turns (turn 10 included) skips one stage

steps.text: The victory condition is getting all your units into the Green Area: each unit leaves the map on entering, and the stage clears once all have left (or the enemy is wiped out). Must be done within 10 turns {≠}{?}
Also must be completed within 10 turns; if Part 1 ran over time, finishing Part 2 quickly doesn't help

entries.result: Both parts achieved → “Warped Space”; otherwise → “Even So, Never Give Up (Part 1)” / “(Part 2)”, one extra stage. Both continue to “A Battle Without Victors” afterwards
notes: Running out of time doesn't cause defeat; it only affects the branch
Tod (Sirbine) joins as reinforcements on the player phase of turn 3 in Part 1; Rose is persuaded in Part 2
akurasu_notes: Akurasu's flowchart says any unit reaching the marked point is enough; the on-screen victory condition is all your units entering the Green Area

entries.title: Muge space or Earth
entries.applies: Independence Army (including fight alone) / OZ (including with Treize)
entries.summary: Choose between going to Muge's space and staying on Earth; the other group temporarily can't deploy but stays on the team

steps.text: After the stage, choose “Go to the Muge universe” → The Last Roar; choose “Remain in the Earth Sphere” → Char's Rebellion
After the stage, choose “Go to the Muge universe” → A Distant Gamble; choose “Remain in the Earth Sphere” → Char's Rebellion

entries.result: Both sides merge at “Terror! Dark Axis Activates! (Part 1)”, where everyone can deploy again
notes: Obtainable only if you stay on Earth: Mashymre or Chara (Independence Army), Neue Ziel (Independence Army), Qubeley Mk-II recolor

Available when going to the Muge universe, unable to deploy when remaining in the Earth Sphere: Bright, Banjo, Alan, Sara, Ryo, Masato, Shinobu, Heero, Duo, Wufei, Trowa, Takeru, Rose, Koji, Boss, Sayaka, Duke, Maria, Ryoma, Hayato, Benkei, Hikaru, Kirika, Naida, Erika, Eiji, David, Simone {+}

Usable if you stay on Earth, cannot deploy if you go to Muge space: the G Gundam pilots and Allenby, Amuro, Kamille, Quattro, Kou, Judau, Shiro, Fa, Roux, Aina, Emma, Ple, Four, Ple-Two, Rosamia, Beecha etc., Quatre, Milliardo, Noin, Hilde, Zechs, Tetsuya, Jun, the Cosmo Crusher team, Hyoma and the rest of the Combattler V group, Daisaku and Ginrei, Ciela, Elle, Show and the rest of the Dunbine group, Julia, Chara, Howard, etc. {+}
The protagonist and anyone on neither list can be used on both sides; Gale is on both lists and can't deploy on either side {?}
Gandor (Dr. Hazuki) can't deploy in “The Last Roar”, “A Distant Gamble” or “Char's Rebellion” {+}
akurasu_notes: Akurasu lists both lineups by series, which doesn't fully match the two rosters in the ROM (e.g. Gale can't deploy on either side)

entries.title: Janera branch: Super Beasts and reinforcements
entries.applies: Independence Army route (including fight alone), picking “Go with Hyoma and the others” in “All-Out Attack on the Cyber Beast Force Base”
entries.summary: Which of the two Super Beasts is destroyed first, and whether Janera is still on the map, decide how the reinforcements play out and whether the Big Sirius appears {+}

steps.text: At the start there are the Super Beast Shishiris Kiba, Shishiris Garo and Janera; the initial defeat condition is Chizuru being destroyed. Reinforcements arrive when the first wave is wiped out or on the turn 4 player phase: while Janera is on the map, whichever Super Beast was destroyed first briefly reappears in a cutscene, then Big Sirius appears, plus Warchimedes's Magma Beast Darkron squad (Warchimedes carries a Chobham Armor) {+}
If Janera has left the battlefield and both Super Beasts were destroyed while she was still there, the reinforcements are only the Darkron squad, without Big Sirius {?}

entries.result: Only changes this stage's enemy lineup; no recruitment or cross-stage effect
notes: Janera retreats at 30% HP or below; she has Super Alloy Z, so shoot her down in a single attack
When the Big Sirius is shot down, Janera also leaves if she's on the map
Similar: other enemy lineups changed by “whether someone is on the map” {+}
“Blade of Anguish”: if Heero isn't on the map, the Wing Gundam (Heero) appears as a third party
“The Sanc Kingdom Falls”: Heero on the map at the start of the player phase on turn 3 → Milliardo appears as an enemy in the Wing Zero; not on the map → he joins as a guest {≠}
“Charge! Destroy the Mobile Fortress! (Part 1)”: when 8 or fewer enemies remain, Dark General on the map → MP Great Mazinger×8; Boss not on the map → Warbeast×9
“The Man Back from Jupiter”: Bask on the map when the area is reached → Virgo×9
“In a World of Endless Strife (Part 2)”: Gandal on the map → Minifo×9
“A Battle Without Victors”: Treize on the map → Wufei appears in the Altron; Haman on the map → Ple appears in the Qubeley
“Lives, Scattered”: if Gato and Chara are on the map, each reappears in a new unit
akurasu_notes: Akurasu says that in “The Sanc Kingdom Falls” he's only an ally if Heero is shot down before Milliardo appears; the script checks whether Heero is on the map at the start of the turn 3 player phase

entries.title: Hidden deployment restrictions
entries.applies: Conditional
entries.summary: In some stages, earlier choices or recruitment progress keep specific characters from deploying at the start (they stay in the team) {+}

steps.text: At the start, pick “Let me think it over a little more” → Ark cannot deploy at first; after Gale's squad appears on the turn 4 player phase (or when the enemy is wiped out), Ark arrives in the Soldifar on the turn 6 player phase or when 6 or fewer enemies remain. Pick “I'll go” to deploy normally
Eiji can't deploy

steps.route: Independence Army route (all three Four steps done)
steps.text: Kamille can't deploy at the start and arrives in the Zeta Gundam in the turn 3 player phase or when the enemy is down to 8 or fewer

All of Four's first three steps done → Kamille can't deploy at the start and arrives on the player phase of turn 4 or when 11 or fewer enemies remain; in Manami's scenario, the earlier steps for Aisha done → Manami can't deploy in this stage
Kamille and Show can't deploy; if Naida was persuaded and you pick “That can wait” at the start → Duke can't deploy either {≠}

If you persuaded Naida: pick “We can't just leave her like this” → Guerrilla cannot deploy; pick “Deal with the enemy for now” → Duke cannot deploy either. No restrictions if you never persuaded her {≠}
Hyoma cannot deploy if the Chizuru surgery path triggers (see the Chizuru surgery branch)
Quatre and Ginrei can't deploy; Gandor (Dr. Hazuki) can't deploy; on the OZ route and the Treize branch, Noin can't deploy either

entries.result: Only restricts deployment at the start or in this stage; doesn't affect recruitment
notes: For deployment changes in the Julia escort stages once Gale joins, see “Gale escorts Julia”
While the team is split between Muge space and Earth, the other group temporarily can't deploy; see “Muge space or Earth”
akurasu_notes: Akurasu's flowchart says Duke can't deploy if Naida wasn't persuaded; the script is the opposite

entries.title: Dialogue-only branches
entries.applies: Common
entries.summary: The choices or conditions below only change dialogue and don't affect recruitment, team composition or route {+}

steps.text: The three-way choice “Y-yes...” / “Leave me alone!” / “...” only changes dialogue

steps.stage_title: The Gundam That Leads to Ruin
steps.text: The two-way choice toward Aisha, “Wait, Aisha!” / “Too bad, Aisha”, only changes dialogue

steps.stage_title: A New Path / The Call of Space / Spreading Malice
steps.text: The squad name “March Wind” two-way choice, “Let's go with that” / “I don't like it”: picking option 2 opens squad-name entry in the original, while this port fixes the squad name and automatically answers option 1
The three-way choice “I don’t have time to play along with your nonsense” / “As if I’d ever think that” / “Silence!” only changes dialogue

steps.stage_title: Death Match! Showdown on Lantau Island (Part 2) / Fist of Despair and Sorrow (Part 2)
steps.route: Independence Army Lantau line / OZ route
steps.text: When Domon defeats Master Asia, the closing dialogue comes in two versions, depending on whether Domon had already fought him before this stage
Noin can persuade Milliardo, dialogue only

steps.route: Independence Army route (never on Complete Pacifism)
steps.text: Noin can persuade Milliardo once more, again dialogue only

entries.result: Dialogue only
notes: After recruiting Kurtz, he has extra lines in “Enter! Super Electromagnetic Robo”, “Conquest of the Earth Sphere”, “Nightmare, Once More”, “The Last Roar”, “Driving Ambition”, “Char's Rebellion” and “A Nightmare with No Waking”. The original has two flaws: on the Complete Pacifism route these lines also appear when Kurtz survives (without joining); and Kurtz's line at the end of “A Distant Gamble” plays whether or not you recruited him
With the Lera branch active, the dialogue differs in over ten stages
The recruitment results for Erika, Ciela / Elle, Aina, Four, Rosamia, Hilde, Naida, Kirika, Ple and others also change individual lines of dialogue in later stages
Once Domon reaches Meikyo Shisui, his skill list shows “Meikyo Shisui” and the finisher lines of the five Shuffle Alliance members switch to a different set
Whether Schwarz survives, and the Chizuru surgery branch, also have their own dialogue — see the corresponding entries
